pc_changelog:
v4.2.0 — Sync Stability & Auth Recovery

• 401 Auth Self-Healing: Firebase tokens auto-recover on expiry
• LAN Download Fallback: Files transfer via LAN when Cloudflare DNS fails
• Instant device list refresh after pairing
• Fixed updater file-locking bug
android_changelog:
v4.1.0 — Smart Sync & File Discovery

• Search bar + category filters (Text, Images, Docs) for quick clip access
• Native MediaStore document scanner — finds PDFs, docs, APKs on all Android devices
• Simplified sync: first connect waits silently, no history dump
• Smart dedup: duplicates move to top instead of being ignored
• Redownload App button in Settings
• Improved Redmi/MIUI file scanning compatibility
